RG 166 AFS licensing: Financial requirements

Issued 21 October 2026

This guide sets out the financial requirements for AFS licensees. Download RG 166 (PDF 1.2 MB)

Who this guide is for

  • Licensees must hold net tangible assets of at least $150,000.
  • Licensees must prepare cash-flow projections every quarter.
